title: decode_body_value() returns ParseError::NoHeaders for range-out-of-bounds
description: decode_body_value() returns Err(ParseError::NoHeaders) when body_range is out of bounds for the supplied raw slice (decode.rs line 29). NoHeaders is semantically wrong for this failure — the actual cause is that the caller supplied a different raw buffer than was used for parsing, or the ParsedPart was not produced from this raw buffer. Users who hit this will search for 'NoHeaders' and find docs about missing RFC 5322 headers. The error type should be a distinct variant (e.g. ParseError::RangeOutOfBounds) or at minimum the doc comment on decode_body_value() must call this out explicitly.
